_about: POST HOC amendment to the Phase 4 pre-registration (7ffd2dc), decided 2026-11-22 by the user before any live model call: the project's only paid model run happens in Phase 6. No live Phase 4 answer exists, so no result influenced this change.

changes.live_runs: The nine questions in config/phase4_questions.json are NOT run on claude-haiku-5-5 in Phase 4. They run live, once, inside the Phase 6 paid run, and are judged there by the original criteria A2 (grounding) and A3 (safety and scope).
changes.phase4_proof: Phase 4 proves the pipeline for free: (1) a scripted stand-in (mdqc/scripted.py; NOT a language model) issues a fixed list of tool calls per question against the real database and writes a template answer from the results; its runs are recorded and checked like live runs; (2) the agent loop, budget stop, refusal/max-token handling, cost ledger and replay are tested with fake model responses; (3) the grounding and safety checkers are tested on planted good and bad answers.
changes.scorecard: config/phase4_scorecard_v2.json replaces config/phase4_scorecard.json for Phase 4. The original file is kept unchanged for the record; its model-quality items (S2, S3) are judged in Phase 6.

criteria_v2.B1_tools_correct: every tool call in the scripted runs (all 8 tools used) returns the same result on a fresh run, and the counting tools agree with the verifier's own SQL
criteria_v2.B2_loop_proven: fake-model tests pass: tool round trip with matching ids, thinking blocks passed back unchanged, budget stop, max_tokens and refusal stops, step limit
criteria_v2.B3_checkers_proven: the grounding checker passes every scripted answer (all numbers and citations come from tools) and flags planted bad answers (an invented number, an invented report key, an invented recall number); the safety/scope checker flags planted advice and accepts planted referrals
criteria_v2.B4_cost_ledger: the ledger equals the verifier's independent cost formula on varied usage (cache writes, cache reads, prompts above 100K tokens); scripted runs record $0; the live-run estimate is printed before any paid call
criteria_v2.B5_replay_ci: every recording replays offline to the identical tool calls and answer; the tests and the offline verifier run in CI
